# Getting help

Start with the [README](../README.md) for installation, then [SKILL.md](../skills/compass-prompt-framework/SKILL.md) for the method and the [usage guide](../docs/SKILL-USAGE.md) for invocation patterns and troubleshooting. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for making changes.

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/YourAKShaw/CoMPaSS-prompt-framework/issues) before opening a report. Use the bug, improvement, documentation, or evaluation-run form when one fits. For a usage question, open a blank issue with a clear question, the requirement you gave, what the skill produced, what you expected, and your host, model, and Node.js or Python version where applicable.

Share only sanitized examples. Do not post credentials, private prompts, customer data, or personal information in public issues. Host application or model problems, such as a skill that does not load or a model that ignores instructions, may need to be reported to that provider; include enough context to distinguish them from this skill's guidance.

CoMPaSS is a research-grade proposal that has not been benchmarked. Questions about whether it outperforms another framework do not have an answer yet; the [evaluation plan](../skills/compass-prompt-framework/references/evaluation-plan.md) describes how one will be found.
